title: Statistics day table (v1/stats/days/YYYY-MM-DD.json)
description: One UTC day of live feed events as columns (format 1), the Statistics screen's input for 24 h, week and month: the event table of kind "day" plus the day's filtered (non-earthquake) times and skipped count. count + filtered.length + skipped = the day's live, non-tombstoned features. APIs.md, Statistics. $defs/eventTable is shared with the year and area files.

filtered.description: times of the filtered live events, ms from t0 (each from t0, not cumulative), ascending

skipped.description: live events without a usable magnitude or position

eventTable.description: Rows sorted by (time, id). time[i] = t0 + t[0] + ... + t[i] (ms). lat/lon x 1e4, mag x 100, depth km x 100, intensity x 10 (mmi, else cdi), rms x 1000, each Math.round. An absent optional column means all null. A new optional column keeps format 1.

t0.description: ms epoch the first delta counts from

providers.description: sorted chosen providers of the rows; prov indexes it

status.description: 1 reviewed, 0 automatic, null not said (from the chosen provenance row)

upd.description: 1 when updated - time > 3,600,000 ms, null without updated

delay.description: seconds from origin to the feed's first ingest
